use_cases: Display animated 3D text effects on hero sections of landing pages
Create decorative curved or bent text for visual branding
Add dynamic typography with theme-aware coloring for dark/light modes
Implement high-quality text rendering using WebGL for performance
Enhance portfolio or creative website visuals with 3D typography
ai_summary: A Three.js-powered 3D text rendering component that creates bendable, high-resolution text with theme support. Uses WebGL with antialiasing and pixel ratio optimization for smooth performance. Renders text as textured planes in a 3D orthographic scene, supporting both dark and light themes through dynamic color detection. Designed for visual impact in hero sections and creative displays.
